_comment: The labelling node of this instance's skills/ (#980: nesting is described FROM WITHIN). Two lists, one node: `topics` names subdirectories that hold skill PACKAGES (bean 9umr, read by scripts/skill-topics.ts); `directories` names INSTANCE directories declared inside skills/ (bean cmsl, owner 2026-09-30, round 4), resolved exactly as if <instance>.json declared them, which it did until this change. Paths are relative to this file's directory.

topics.title: Content authoring
topics.description: Content-type skill packages: how a folio of a given content type is authored, reviewed, validated and published. Declared HERE because this is the lowest instance holding a `skills/content/` directory (placement PR1, bean ybwt): the same-named directory of every instance stacked on this one is a MEMBER of it (bean 1g4s, option A), never a group of its own. When placement PR2 regroups the harness's `authoring` topic as `content`, the declaration moves down to the harness and this entry is removed.

directories.description: Voice skills this layer owns. `technical-writer` is the whole of it: an SDO register (W3C, IHE) with RFC 2119 requirement levels, read from the two ingested RFCs and constrained by RFC 8174. PLACED HERE BY JUDGEMENT, on the owner's ruling of 2026-09-21: *"voices should be associated to appropriate home semantically/by judgement"*. It arrived on `main` in `cat-harness/voices/` while the migration to `<instance>/skills/voices/` was in flight (bean `btuv`), and the two obvious mechanical homes are both wrong — the PLATFORM holds no voice content, and `agent-skills` merely holds the RFCs it cites, which has never decided ownership (`who-editorial` cites who-iris's library and lived in who-style-guide until the owner folded the style guide into who-iris as derivative content on 2026-09-30 -- a ruling about what it IS, not a rule that a voice follows its source). What settles it is what the voice is ABOUT: how to write technical documentation of a standard, software or a knowledge asset — which is what this layer is for. (The two RFCs moved with the rest of the agent-skills corpus into cat-harness's `library/` when agent-skills dissolved into cat-harness on 2026-10-01, bean `j7ql`; the citations name `litlfred/cat-harness` since. Citing DOWN into the harness is the allowed direction, and where a cited corpus sits still decides nothing about who owns the voice.)
